cover_letter:
Dear Ventory Team,

I am excited to apply for the Growth Hacker / Communications Manager role at Ventory. Your mission to provide real-time visibility of field inventory resonates with my technical background and passion for data-driven marketing. With 3+ years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am confident I can contribute to your growth engine from day one.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console. These skills directly translate to running growth experiments across SEO, content, and lifecycle campaigns, and to measuring everything to ensure ROI.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to turn a technical value proposition into accessible messaging. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD) and entity optimization, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This experience aligns with your focus on SEO/GEO and your need to communicate complex enterprise solutions clearly.

I am a builder at heart, thriving with autonomy in lean startup environments. I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, with the right to work here, and I am fluent in English (professional) and Turkish (native), with Dutch at B1 and improving. I am eager to partner with your sales team to convert demand into qualified pipeline and to own Ventory's external communications.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can drive growth at Ventory.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

# Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
